heading: The Science of The O Concept™
intro: Four clinical phases, one coherent protocol — created by Dr Wakil, and now taught by him to physicians worldwide.

image.alt: Advanced clinical technology at Dr SW Clinics, Harley Street
image.caption: Regenerative · Energy-based · Hormonal

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.text: Every protocol begins with the Endo Test — a comprehensive hormonal, metabolic and vascular panel. We measure before we treat, because sexual function is physiology, and physiology leaves evidence.
steps.detail: Full endocrine panel · vascular assessment · lifestyle and psychological screening

steps.title: Regenerate
steps.text: Platelet-rich plasma, growth factors and the body’s own blood products regenerate vascular and nerve tissue at the source. This is the regenerative core Dr Wakil introduced to the UK — the O-Shot® and P-Shot®.
steps.detail: O-Shot® · P-Shot® · stem cells & growth factors · autologous blood products

steps.title: Restore
steps.text: Energy-based medicine restores what time and physiology have taken: low-intensity shockwave rebuilds blood supply, radiofrequency and laser restore tissue quality, electromagnetic therapy rebuilds the pelvic floor.
steps.detail: ESWT shockwave · Ultra Femme 360 · CO2RE Intima · O Concept™ Chair

steps.title: Optimise
steps.text: Results are maintained, not merely achieved. Hormonal optimisation, nutrition, supplementation and scheduled diagnostics keep function — and confidence — quietly compounding year on year.
steps.detail: Hormone optimisation · IV nutrition · dietician programmes · ongoing review

handover.alt: Treatment suite at Dr SW Clinics
handover.caption: Twenty-five thousand cases of evidence — *one* protocol.

closing.heading: Function, sensation and confidence — *measured, restored, maintained.*
closing.text: Not a procedure but a protocol: diagnostics first, regeneration at the cause, restoration with energy-based medicine, and optimisation that never stands still. This is the method the world now trains in — with the physician who created it.
